items.title: 14.4 Simple harmonic motion aur yaksan daairavi harkat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of S.H.M. and uniform circular motion (PDF 25-28).

blocks.text: S.H.M. ko yaksan daairavi harkat (uniform circular motion) se jor kar samjha ja sakta hai. Jab zarra yaksan raftar se daire mein ghoomta hai to daire ke qutr (diameter) par us ka saya (projection) S.H.M. karta hai. Radius r ki turntable lein jis ke kinare par gend lagi ho; roshni ki shua gend ka saya screen par dalti hai (Fig 14.4). Jab turntable yaksan angular raftar w se ghoomti hai to gend yaksan daairavi harkat karti aur us ka saya screen par spring par lagi kamiyat ki tarah S.H.M. mein aage peeche chalta hai.

blocks.alt: Projector ki roshni oopar se turntable par parti hai jis ke kinare par gend (ball) lagi hai; mura teer gend ki daairavi harkat dikhata hai. Neeche screen par gend ka saya (shadow) aage peeche chalta hai: oscillation of ball's shadow.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.4: Screen par gend ke saye ka jhoolna. Gend yaksan ghoomti turntable se lagi hai (kitab ki Figure 14.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Zarra P radius xo ke daire mein yaksan angular velocity w se ghoomta hai; P par us ki linear velocity tangent ke saath vp = xo w hai. Q qutr par P ka saya hai, jo darmiyani jagah O ke gird jhoolta hai. Agar P, A se shuru ho to waqt t mein tay zawiya theta = wt hai (Fig 14.5).

blocks.alt: Radius xo ka daira, markaz O, ufqi qutr (diameter) jis ka sira A. Daire par nuqta P angular velocity omega se ghari ki ulti simt ghoomta hai; radius OP, OA ke saath zawiya theta = omega t banata hai. Q qutr par P se giraya amood ka paon hai, aur x = OQ, O se Q ka displacement hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.5: Yaksan angular velocity se daire par chalta nuqta P (kitab ki Figure 14.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Lamhati displacement: tikon POQ mein OQ/OP = cos(theta), is liye x / xo = cos(wt) aur x = xo cos(wt) (14.11).

Lamhati velocity: Q ki velocity vp ka ufqi hissa hai (Fig 14.6): v = vp cos(90 darje - theta) = xo w sin(wt) (14.12). sin^2 + cos^2 = 1 aur cos(theta) = x/xo se v = w x (xo^2 - x^2) ka square root = [(k/m)(xo^2 - x^2)] ka square root (14.13). Darmiyani jagah par x = 0, is liye velocity zyada se zyada hai: v_max = vo = xo w = (k/m) ka square root x xo (14.14).

blocks.alt: Wahi daira, qutr BA. P par velocity vp tangent ke saath hai. Is ka ufqi hissa v, P se amudi qutr par R tak, BA ke mutawazi, aur barabar teer v, Q par qutr ke saath O ki taraf. vp aur amudi lakeer ka zawiya theta, aur vp aur PR ka zawiya 90 darje minus theta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.6: Nuqta P ki velocity aur us ka ufqi hissa (kitab ki Figure 14.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Nishanaat aur chhapi equation 14.13
blocks.text: Kitab equation 14.13 ko v = w x (xo - x^2) ka square root = [(k/m)(xo^2 - xo^2)] ka square root chhapti hai; durust shakal v = w x (xo^2 - x^2) ka square root hai. Q ki raftar xo w sin(wt) hai; kyunke x musbat hone par Q, O ki taraf chalta hai, us ki velocity v = -xo w sin(wt) hai.

items: Lamhati acceleration: P ka acceleration markaz ki taraf centripetal hai, ap = xo w^2 (Fig 14.7). Q ka acceleration is ka ufqi hissa hai: a = -xo w^2 cos(theta) = -xo w^2 (x/xo), is liye a = -w^2 x (14.15). Kyunke w constant hai, a mutanasib -x: S.H.M. ki shart.

blocks.alt: Wahi daira, nuqte A, B aur C. P ka centripetal acceleration ap, PO ke saath markaz ki taraf hai. Is ka ufqi hissa a, Q par qutr BA ke saath O ki taraf amal karta hai. Zawiya theta O aur P par likha hai, aur x faasla OQ hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.7: Nuqta P ka acceleration aur us ka ufqi hissa (kitab ki Figure 14.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Zarre ke saye ke liye durust time period, displacement, velocity aur acceleration ke formulas daire mein ghoomte zarre par bhi laagu hote hain.

0.2 kg kamiyat k = 10 N m^-1 wale spring se bandhi hai. Ise tawazun se 0.1 m hata kar rest se chhora jata hai. x = 0.05 m par (a) acceleration aur (b) raftar maloom karein. Hal: w = (k/m) ka square root = (10/0.2) ka square root = 50 ka square root, taqreeban 7.07 rad s^-1. (a) a = -w^2 x = -50 x 0.05 = -2.5 m s^-2. (b) v = w x (xo^2 - x^2) ka square root = 7.07 x (0.01 - 0.0025) ka square root = 7.07 x 0.0866, taqreeban 0.612 m s^-1.

items: Yaksan daairavi harkat ka qutr par saya S.H.M. hai.
x = xo cos(wt); raftar w sqrt(xo^2 - x^2); O par v_max = xo w.
a = -w^2 x; intehaon par zyada se zyada xo w^2.
